exposure: high-intensity signals in T2-weighted images (T2WI) of the retroplacental basal decidual space
cohort: The study included patients with clinically and pathologically confirmed placenta implantation and complete placental abruption.
finding: High-intensity signals in T2WI of the retroplacental basal decidual space were not observed in patients with placenta implantation, suggesting this finding could be used as exclusion criteria for MR diagnosis of placenta implantation.
